# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 22 years old by the end of Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c4 P2](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and mother  <sub>[v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c1 P10](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Gideon Duckett  <sub>[v3 c37 P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Izzy  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v4 c1 P21](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is an extremely attractive young woman featuring rosy, dimpled cheeks, dark eyes, and dark, shiny hair. Though she is somewhat plumper and shorter than her friend Nell Harcourt, her beauty is widely admired by the Brierley youth. As she matures and becomes a mother, her complexion retains its rose-like bloom and her dark eyes remain bright.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P20](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0020), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Isolde has a cheerful, open, and pragmatic disposition, frequently bursting into laughter before speaking. While less imaginative than Nell, she is deeply loyal, warm-hearted, and affectionate toward her closest friends and family. She is practical and grounded, yet capable of joining enthusiastically in romantic pledges and imaginative play. As a mature woman, she is a devoted, proud, and caring mother.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c1 P10](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0010)_

## Goals

- To remain devoted lifelong friends with Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>
- To build a happy family and home with Gideon Duckett  <sub>[v1 c29 P28](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0028), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>

## History

Isolde Pembroke grows up at Pear Hill in Brierley. After meeting Nell Harcourt in the summer after Nell's arrival, the two girls become inseparable bosom friends, swearing a solemn vow of lifelong loyalty over the brook. Together they name local landmarks, build playhouses, attend Brierley school, and participate in community events like Sunday-school picnics and concerts. Their bond faces a temporary trial when Isolde accidentally gets intoxicated on homemade currant wine at Grey Shutters, leading her strict mother to briefly forbid their playtimes, but the misunderstanding is soon cleared up after Nell helps save Isolde's younger sister Posy Fay from croup. As she grows up, Isolde joins the Brierley Village Improvement Society, attends local social events, and falls in love with Gideon Duckett. The two marry when Isolde is eighteen, establishing their own home nearby. Four years into her marriage, Isolde is a happy homemaker and the mother of two children, including her daughter Small Nell Lucinda, while remaining as devoted a friend to Nell as ever.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P24](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0024), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P57](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0057), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c29 P28](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0028), [v3 c37 P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c1 P10](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mr. Pembroke and Mrs. Pembroke of Pear Hill  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- Named by a schoolmaster who was lodging with her parents when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Great-niece of Miss Lavinia Pembroke of Port Marlow  <sub>[v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>

## Quotes

> I solemnly swear to remain loyal to my bosom friend, Nell Harcourt, for as long as the sun and moon endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035)</sub>

> You can be certain that my love for you, Nell, is devoted and will last forever.  <sub>[v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>

> I’m so happy, yet the idea of my engagement feels completely absurd.  <sub>[v1 c29 P15](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0015)</sub>

> It’s been a pleasant summer. And the crowning moment of it all appeared to be Miss Rosalind’s wedding.  <sub>[v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002)</sub>

> All is altering—or about to alter. Nell, I possess a sense that conditions are not ever going to be what they were.  <sub>[v3 c1 P14](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0014)</sub>
